root_node: Far and Near (Metric Length Units & Conversions)

key_nodes: Metre (m): Room dimensions, cloth, track lengths
Kilometre (km): Long distances between towns and cities
Larger to smaller unit: Multiply by conversion factor (e.g., 3.5 km = 3,500 m)
Smaller to larger unit: Divide by conversion factor (e.g., 250 cm = 2.5 m)
Double Number Lines for visual proportional scale mapping
sub_branches.misconception_alert: Multiplying instead of dividing when converting smaller units to larger units.

key_nodes: Addition & Subtraction of compound lengths (m and cm, km and m)
Map Scale Translations (e.g., 1 cm on map = 10 km on ground)
Fabric requirements and per-metre cost calculations
sub_branches.real_world_application: Tailoring cloth cuts, athletic race track measurements, and road map scale reading.
